checks: The sum of the two positive q-fiber directions is the direction of their Minkowski sum. At an integral midpoint of a same-parity pair its dimension is at most q, which forces the common direction and exact affine midpoint hull.

Every positive ordered overlap pairs q-fibers with bases adding to twice the center, hence same parity; any such center is on a q-fiber. Borel measurability follows by integrating the indicator of the compact reflected membership relation.

For each ordered pair, Tonelli on the common Euclidean q-plane and v=2ξ−u give the Jacobian 2^(−q). The image lies in the actual midpoint fiber. For q=0 the direct ordered-pair count gives factor one.

Expanding the independent midpoint product gives second moment (M_r Q_r+m_r m_r^T)/2. Both normalized laws have weights M_r²/A and common conditional mean g_r. Conditional averaging halves the within-class covariance and leaves the between-class covariance unchanged.

The perpendicular-segment hull is a tetrahedron with only bases 0 and 1. The parity masses 2,4 and first moments (0,2,0),(4,0,12) yield correlation mass 10 and first moment (8,2,24). Independently integrated the four-interval example: mass 225/2, first moments (375/2,1653/4) and second-moment entries (701/2,2861/4,31885/16) equal half the product moments.
Checked source 93cf42ea22bcd767 §§1–3, 5–6 and replayed its exact verifier. The frozen law is compared to the parity-size-reweighted original law, as in the source.

overlap.comparison: Its q>0 convex-body statement gives common direction and affine offset for cross products of absolutely continuous same-parity endpoint measures. The frozen proof rederives this geometry for the needed fiber pairs and additionally proves the exact reflection density, mixed moments and counting case.

It gives support, mass, first moment, and halfspace domination for differently normalized parity products. The reflection density and exact covariance formula for the present parity-size-squared mixture are additional.

For fixed full-dimensional reflected stars it integrates endpoint overlap against constant center-fiber volume, giving a scalar special case of the Jacobian calculation. It does not give the intrinsic measure identity for every test, all bases and parities, or the moment law.

readability: The ordered pair convention and the factor 2^(−q) are kept separate from class sampling normalization.
review_method: Independent cold read of the exact frozen statement and proof, then source and predecessor comparison and exact arithmetic checks where relevant.
summary: The ordered parity-class midpoint pushforward has the stated exact intrinsic reflection density, moment and covariance identities, including counting measure.
